allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange about grant of Stock Options under the  Inox Wind - Employee Stock Option Scheme 2024

allot.subject: Monitoring Agency Report
allot.text: Report of the Monitoring Agency with respect to utilisation of proceeds from Rights Issue of the Company

allot.subject: ESOP/ESOS/ESPS
allot.text: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Grant of 336500  Options.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Allotment of Equity Shares under Rights Issue'.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Letter of Offer for the Rights Issue of Equity Shares of the Company'.

allot.subject: Record Date
allot.text: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Rights Issue is 29-Jul-2025.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on July 23, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 5 : 78, i.e 5 Equity Shares for every 78 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 120 per share.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on July 17, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares by way of rights issue.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Allotment of equity shares  pursuant to the Scheme of Arrangement '.
